title: bromus molliformis subsp. humilis
intro: Bromus molliformis subsp. humilis, commonly known as Brome grass or False Brome, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family, Poaceae. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Brome grass include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic agent. The bioactive constituents of Bromus molliformis subsp. humilis include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
